snippet.title: CLAUDE CODE FULL COURSE 4 HOURS: Build & Sell (2026)
snippet.description:
🔥 Join Maker School & get customer #1 guaranteed: https://skool.com/makerschool/about
📁 Get all Claude course resources 100% free: https://skool.com/maker-zero/about
➡️ If this is your first video: I'm Nick Saraev. I run LeftClick, an AI growth agency. We've done work for large brands you're likely familiar with, like Mr. Beast, Anthropic, OpenAI, and a few others.

In plain English: I help people build systems that generate leads, close deals, and scale businesses, mostly using new AI models like Claude. I also make videos about how to do all of that here on YouTube.

It hasn't always been this way. My family immigrated from a Soviet bloc country (People's Republic of Bulgaria) in the 90s. They worked extremely hard, and we were broke for a very long time. I grew up wishing for more security, stability, and freedom over my own life.

I don't have a programming degree, and never took formal education for IT or workflows. I learned it all myself from YouTube videos like you're watching now.

As for my path: I started my first business at 19 in college. We threw events (mostly parties) at campus bars, and charged people for entry. 

That failed to provide me enough money to pay my bills, so at 21, I started another business, a door-to-door marketing agency.

From there, every year, I would start several companies, over 10 in total. I did this in a variety of industries, like e-commerce, photography, videography, SaaS, credit repair, etc. Each grew slightly more profitable, until, at 25, I would start 1SecondCopy, a content writing company. A friend and I eventually scaled that to over $90,000/m. It was my first taste of financial independence, and the reason I'm here today.

The hedge fund method is how quants actually trade — and it has nothing to do with trend lines, indicators, or vibes. It's a Markov regime model that quantifies the market into three states: bull, bear, and sideways. And once you see it, you can't unsee it.

Here's the core. You label every day in an asset's history based on the trailing 20-day return — 5% or more is a bull state, -5% or worse is a bear state, everything else is sideways. Then you count every transition between states and turn those counts into a 3x3 transition matrix of probabilities. That matrix tells you the odds of tomorrow's regime based only on today.

This is the opposite of how retail trades. You're not guessing. You're calculating. The Markov property says the past doesn't matter — only the current state determines what comes next, and the stickiness of each regime tells you how to size the trade.

I'll walk you through squaring the matrix for multi-day forecasts, the stationary distribution that explains why 28-day predictions collapse, signal generation by subtracting bear probability from bull probability, and the walk-forward backtest that stops your strategy from cheating with future data. Then the hidden Markov model removes the subjective labels entirely.

You'll get a free Claude Code skill and a Pine Script overlay for TradingView — copy, paste, done. This is real quant Markov regime trading.

snippet.title: CLAUDE CODE MARKETING FULL COURSE (6 HOURS)
snippet.description:
🔥 Join Maker School & get customer #1 guaranteed: https://skool.com/makerschool/about
💎 Get all course resources 100% free: https://skool.com/maker-zero/about
🖇️ Claude: https://claude.ai CRM: https://clickup.ai Video AI: https://higgsfield.ai/s/tWhJfK

If this is your first video: I'm Nick Saraev. I run LeftClick, an AI growth agency. We've done work for large brands you're likely familiar with, like Mr. Beast, Anthropic, OpenAI, and a few others.

In plain English: I help people build systems that generate leads, close deals, and scale businesses, mostly using new AI models like Claude. I also make videos about how to do all of that here on YouTube.

It hasn't always been this way. My family immigrated from a Soviet bloc country (People's Republic of Bulgaria) in the 90s. They worked extremely hard, and we were broke for a very long time. I grew up wishing for more security, stability, and freedom over my own life.

I don't have a programming degree, and never took formal education for IT or workflows. I learned it all myself from YouTube videos like you're watching now.

As for my path: I started my first business at 19 in college. We threw events (mostly parties) at campus bars, and charged people for entry. 

That failed to provide me enough money to pay my bills, so at 21, I started another business, a door-to-door marketing agency.

From there, every year, I would start several companies, over 10 in total. I did this in a variety of industries, like e-commerce, photography, videography, SaaS, credit repair, etc. Each grew slightly more profitable, until, at 25, I would start 1SecondCopy, a content writing company. A friend and I eventually scaled that to over $90,000/m. It was my first taste of financial independence, and the reason I'm here today.

Since starting my journey, I've grown a fair bit of capital. To diversify my income, at 30, I began investing in other businesses and advising companies on how to grow in the AI era. These include SaaS businesses, like Clairvo, agencies like Dental Connect, and more. 

Collectively, the businesses that I own outright or are a part of generate over $10 million per year. This returns far more than the 5-10% you would get in the stock market, but also requires a lot of my active time. There's a tradeoff there, but I greatly prefer active investing, where I have control over the entities I'm a part of.

It wasn't easy to get here. But I did in the end! For anyone on their own entrepreneurial journey: I wish you luck, happiness, and perseverance. You can make it!

Summary ⤵️
This is THE Claude Code for Marketing course. In it, I will show you how to use Claude Code to replace virtually *every* marketing function, from the generation of creative, to speed to lead, to database/dashboard design, and finally followups.

There's a tradeoff there, but I greatly prefer active investing, where I have control over the entities I'm a part of.

It wasn't easy to get here. But I did in the end! For anyone on their own entrepreneurial journey: I wish you luck, happiness, and perseverance. You can make it!

snippet.title: How a Math Prodigy Built Claude, OpenAI's Worst Nightmare | What Made 7 People Leave OpenAI?
snippet.description:
In September 2026, the New York Times reports that one AI company is on pace to bring in more than $100 billion a year. The same month, a US appeals court sides against it, with the Pentagon. The company is Anthropic, the maker of Claude. It was started by seven people who walked out of OpenAI together, because they weren't sure powerful AI would go well. So how did the careful ones end up here?

This is the story of Anthropic and Claude, explained simply.

It starts with a boy in San Francisco who didn't care about the internet. Dario Amodei liked maths and studied physics. After his father died of an illness that was cured a few years later, he moved to biology, and then to AI. He joined OpenAI in 2016, and his team built GPT-2 and GPT-3. At the end of 2020, Dario, his sister Daniela and five colleagues left. Anthropic began in 2021, with its first staff eating lunch in a San Francisco park in the middle of a pandemic. In 2022 it held its chatbot, Claude, back; about three months later, OpenAI released ChatGPT. Then came Claude's "constitution", a promise to pause, billions of dollars from Amazon and Google, Claude Code, and a fight with the Pentagon over two exceptions: no mass surveillance of Americans, and no weapons that pick targets and fire on their own.

Then the video follows the money: what Claude is, where Anthropic's money comes from (a draft of its stock-market filing, seen by Reuters, says $4.6 billion in 2025), what it spends on computers, the $518 billion of future computer bills Reuters reports, the authors' lawsuit, what Anthropic says, what happened, and what could happen next. Complex ideas, explained in simple language.

A note from us: we use Claude to help make these videos, so we checked every flattering claim twice.

snippet.title: 1 Person Company with 7 AI Tools | Make Money with Claude & ChatGPT
snippet.description:
✅ Join No Code App Building Bootcamp 👉 https://roydigital.in/nocode-bootcamp

Aaj ki date mein maximum log har kaam ke liye sirf ek hi AI app use karte hain, aur wo hai ChatGPT. Ye bilkul waisa hai jaise dukaan mein ek hi ladka rakha ho jo subah dukaan kholne se le kar safai, purchase, customer aur shaam ka hisaab tak sab kuch akela kare. Kaam ho jaata hai, par har kaam mein best nahi hota.

Is video mein main aapko apne 7 AI employees se milwata hoon, yaani wo 7 AI tools jo main khud apni one person company mein use karta hoon. Har tool kis kaam ke liye best hai, kaise shuru karein, uska chhota sa catch kya hai, aur end mein wo ek galti jo zyada tar log karte hain.

Video ke 7 AI employees:

1. ChatGPT: roz ke kaam, post ideas, WhatsApp reply, offer banner image, voice mode, memory
2. Claude: Projects mein apne business ka brief de kar proper proposal aur lamba kaam
3. Gemini: Google ka apna AI, Gmail, Drive aur YouTube ke saath
4. Perplexity: research jo sources ke saath aati hai
5. Gemini Notebook (NotebookLM): apne documents aur PDFs se summary aur audio overview
6. Canva: ready templates aur type karke design
7. Make.com: bina coding automation, jaise Gmail aur ChatGPT ko jod kar reply

Sabse badi galti: AI kholo, ek sawaal pucho aur jo generic reply aaye use hi answer maan lo. Iska fix hai brain of your business, yaani ek document jisme aapke business aur aapke baare mein utni info ho jitni aap share karne mein comfortable ho. Har AI tool ko isse ek baar train karo, phir answer generic nahi, aapke business ke hisaab se aata hai.

Live App Building Bootcamp: 3 ghante mein bina coding, free tools se apna Android app banana, live. Date, time aur fee ki details yahan (seats limited):
https://roydigital.in/nocode-bootcamp

Claude ko main poori company ki tarah kaise use karta hoon, wo poora video yahan:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oMw4JdxoX_A

Plans aur free limits time ke saath badalte rehte hain: Make.com ka free plan abhi 1,000 credits per month deta hai, aur Gmail/Drive ke andar Gemini ke kuch features paid Google plan mein aate hain. snippet.title: How to Make a Roblox Game With AI (Claude Opus 5.5 Full Tutorial)
snippet.description:
How to make a Roblox game with AI: my full Claude Code workflow, every tool, model and API, and how to set it up yourself.

MY AI ROBLOX DEV COURSE: everything I've personally learned about using AI for Roblox development, out now: https://payhip.com/b/S9gWL

After my AI-made Roblox game videos, the most common comment was asking for a tutorial. So this is the whole system behind them: how I use Claude Code (running Claude Opus 5.5) to build entire Roblox games, from the code and the UI to maps, VFX, sound, animation and 3D models, and why I picked every tool along the way.

You'll learn what Claude Code skills are and how a SKILL.md file works (name, description, scripts and references), how to make your own skill or let the skill creator build one for you, and how MCP (Model Context Protocol) connects Claude to Roblox Studio. I show the step-by-step setup for the built-in Roblox Studio MCP server, how Rojo keeps the Luau code in files, and how to set up a Roblox Open Cloud API key safely so Claude can upload models and images straight into your game without ever pasting the key into the chat.

For the parts Claude can't do on its own, I break down the AI models and APIs I use and what they cost: Flux on Cloudflare Workers AI for images and icons, Hi3DGen on a free Kaggle GPU for 3D models, Blender to get them under Roblox's triangle limit, and the Roblox Open Cloud API for uploads. Then I go through every skill one by one and how my create-roblox-game skill manages the research, design and build of a whole game.

This is for Roblox developers and beginners who want to build games with AI properly, not just paste ChatGPT scripts into Roblox Studio.
